title: Call, text, email or map a client

steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: Call, text, email or find a client without typing anything in. Start on Clients.

steps.caption: Open the client
steps.narration: Open a client. We'll use Imani Brewster.

steps.caption: The contact row
steps.narration: Under her name are the email, the phone number and the address. Each one is a link.

steps.caption: Email
steps.narration: Click the email address, and a new email to her starts in your mail app.

steps.caption: Call
steps.narration: Click the phone number to call her.

steps.caption: On a phone
steps.narration: On your phone, that opens the dialer with the number filled in.

steps.caption: The call button
steps.narration: The small phone button beside it does the same.

steps.caption: The text button
steps.narration: And the speech bubble starts a text message to that number.

steps.caption: Maps
steps.narration: Click the address, and it opens in Maps in a new tab.

steps.caption: Directions
steps.narration: From there you can get directions to the job.

steps.caption: Your own apps
steps.narration: These shortcuts use the phone, texting and mail apps of the device you are on.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: They are at the top of every client's page, under Clients.

youtube.title: Call, text, email or map a client in one click | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: The contact row at the top of a client's page in ConstructHUB CRM: click the email address to write, the phone number to call, the small buttons to call or text, and the address to open it in Maps. The walkthrough uses a demo company and a demo client.
